title: Observational Study to Understand Patients' and Physicians' Attitudes to Statins in TurkeY

sections.abstract: In Turkey statin compliance is lower than EU countries. (EURIKA). We will assess the underlying causes of statin incompliance. The investigators will build patient and physician education programs to improve compliance in TURKEY. Our aim is to assess patients' and physicians' attitudes to statins by mean of HABIT Patient and Physician survey respectively.
